ucs.title: [LLM] Octo Tempest help-desk MFA reset followed by new-IP sign-in (Scattered Spider vishing pattern)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Scattered Spider / UNC3944 initial-access chain: a social-engineered help-desk operator resets a user's MFA / security info, and within minutes the attacker signs in from a new IP/ASN using the freshly-enrolled authenticator. This pairs the directory-admin event with the immediately-following sign-in to suppress legitimate self-service resets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as resetTime from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.object_category=User All_Changes.action=updated (All_Changes.change_type="AAA" OR All_Changes.command IN ("Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Update user","Disable Strong Authentication")) by All_Changes.user All_Changes.src All_Changes.object All_Changes.command | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Changes")` | rename object as targetUser user as adminUser src as adminSrc | join type=inner targetUser [| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as signinTime values(Authentication.src) as signinSrc values(Authentication.src_user_agent) as ua values(Authentication.app) as app from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.signature_id IN ("1","AzureActiveDirectory") by Authentication.user | `drop_dm_object_name("Authentication")` | rename user as targetUser] | where signinTime>=resetTime AND signinTime<=resetTime+7200 AND signinSrc!=adminSrc | eval deltaSec=signinTime-resetTime | convert ctime(resetTime) ctime(signinTime) | table resetTime,signinTime,deltaSec,adminUser,adminSrc,targetUser,signinSrc,ua,app
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowHours = 2h;
let MFAResets = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in~ ("Office 365","Microsoft Azure")
    | where ActionType in~ ("Update user.","Reset user password.","Reset password (by admin).","User registered security info.","Admin registered security info.","User changed default security info.","Disable Strong Authentication.","Set Company Information.")
    | extend TargetUser = tolower(tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name))
    | where isnotempty(TargetUser)
    | project ResetTime=Timestamp, AdminUpn=AccountDisplayName, AdminIP=IPAddress, AdminCountry=CountryCode, ResetAction=ActionType, TargetUser;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ErrorCode == 0
| extend AcctLower = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner MFAResets on $left.AcctLower == $right.TargetUser
| where Timestamp between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowHours)
| where IPAddress != AdminIP
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, ResetTime)
| where DelaySec >= 0
| project ResetTime, SignInTime=Timestamp, DelaySec, ResetAction, AdminUpn, AdminIP, AdminCountry, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, AppDisplayName, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by SignInTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowHours = 2h;
let MFAResets = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in ("Update user","Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","User changed default security info","Disable Strong Authentication")
    | where Result == "success"
    | extend AdminUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend AdminIP  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUser = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | where isnotempty(TargetUser) and AdminUpn != TargetUser   // self-service excluded
    | project ResetTime=TimeGenerated, ResetAction=OperationName, AdminUpn, AdminIP, TargetUser;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ResultType == 0
| extend UpnLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner MFAResets on $left.UpnLower == $right.TargetUser
| where TimeGenerated between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowHours)
| where IPAddress != AdminIP
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, SignInTime=TimeGenerated, DelaySec, ResetAction, AdminUpn, AdminIP, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, tostring(Location), AppDisplayName, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState
| order by SignInTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory (@evt.name:"Update user" OR @evt.name:"Reset user password" OR @evt.name:"Reset password (by admin)" OR @evt.name:"User registered security info" OR @evt.name:"Admin registered security info" OR @evt.name:"Disable Strong Authentication") @evt.outcome:success -@identity.claim.upn:@user.userPrincipalName
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog (EventAction=/UserRegisteredSecurityInfo/i OR EventAction=/ResetUserPassword/i OR EventAction=/AdminRegisteredSecurityInfo/i OR EventAction=/DisableStrongAuthentication/i)
| ResetActor:=ActorUserPrincipalName
| ResetActorIp:=ClientIp
| TargetUser:=TargetUserPrincipalName
| ResetTime:=@timestamp
| join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog EventAction=/SignIn/i Outcome=Success}, field=TargetUser, key=UserPrincipalName, include=[ClientIp, @timestamp, AppDisplayName])
| ClientIp != ResetActorIp
| @timestamp - ResetTime < 7200000
| groupBy([ResetActor, ResetActorIp, TargetUser, ClientIp, AppDisplayName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Scattered Spider's defining initial-access TTP since 2022 is help-desk vishing to reset MFA/security info on a target identity (Microsoft Octo Tempest reporting, CISA AA23-320A). Generic 'risky sign-in' detections miss this because the post-reset sign-in is policy-clean — the only signal is the tight temporal coupling between an admin-initiated security-info change and a sign-in from a different I

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider commodity RMM foothold (AnyDesk / ScreenConnect / Splashtop / Pulseway / Fleetdeck / ngrok first-seen on workstation)
ucs.description: Hunts the install/execution of Scattered Spider's documented RMM-tool catalogue on hosts where it has never been seen in the prior 30 days. UNC3944 deliberately avoids custom malware and instead drops signed commercial RMM binaries plus ngrok tunnels for hands-on-keyboard persistence after the help-desk-driven Entra takeover.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen values(Processes.process) as cmdLine values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","splashtopsos.exe","srmanager.exe","pulseway.exe","pcmonitorsrv.exe","ngrok.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","fleetdeck_commander.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","atera*.exe","agentpackagenetworkconfiguration.exe","syncroservice.exe","actionrmm.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","rport.exe","localtonet.exe","chisel.exe") by host Processes.process_name Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval bucket=relative_time(now(),"-30d@d") | where firstSeen>=bucket | sort - firstSeen
ucs.kql:
let RMM = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","splashtopsos.exe","srmanager.exe","pulseway.exe","pcmonitorsrv.exe","ngrok.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","fleetdeck_commander.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","ateraagent.exe","syncroservice.exe","actionrmm.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","rport.exe","localtonet.exe","chisel.exe"]);
let Baseline = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where FileName in~ (RMM)
    | summarize by DeviceName, FileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ (RMM)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on DeviceName, FileName
| extend RemoteSession = column_ifexists("IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession", false)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountUpn, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, RemoteSession
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RMM = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","splashtopsos.exe","srmanager.exe","pulseway.exe","pcmonitorsrv.exe","ngrok.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","fleetdeck_commander.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","ateraagent.exe","syncroservice.exe","actionrmm.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","rport.exe","localtonet.exe","chisel.exe"]);
let Baseline = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where Bin in~ (RMM)
    | summarize by Computer, Bin;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Bin in~ (RMM)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on Computer, Bin
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, Bin, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: d4f1c6e2-9a7b-4f23-b1c0-1ab2f3c4d5e6
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of commercial RMM binaries known to be abused by Scattered Spider (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest) for hands-on-keyboard access after Entra ID takeover.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/28
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.t1219
  - detection.threat_hunting
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_rmm:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\anydesk.exe'
      - '\screenconnect.clientservice.exe'
      - '\screenconnect.windowsclient.exe'
      - '\connectwisecontrol.client.exe'
      - '\splashtop.exe'
      - '\splashtopstreamer.exe'
      - '\splashtopsos.exe'
      - '\pulseway.exe'
      - '\pcmonitorsrv.exe'
      - '\ngrok.exe'
      - '\fleetdeck_agent.exe'
      - '\fleetdeck_commander.exe'
      - '\teamviewer.exe'
      - '\teamviewer_service.exe'
      - '\ateraagent.exe'
      - '\syncroservice.exe'
      - '\actionrmm.exe'
      - '\tacticalrmm.exe'
      - '\rport.exe'
      - '\localtonet.exe'
      - '\chisel.exe'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_rmm and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned RMM tool for the helpdesk team (allow-list per device)
  - IT staff initiated remote support session
level: high

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|screenconnect\.clientservice|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.client|splashtop|splashtopstreamer|splashtopsos|srmanager|pulseway|pcmonitorsrv|ngrok|fleetdeck_agent|fleetdeck_commander|teamviewer|teamviewer_service|ateraagent|syncroservice|actionrmm|tacticalrmm|rport|localtonet|chisel)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/

| _count > 0
| sort(field=_min, order=desc)
